messages:
Ava: I opened PR #2473 to simplify the Hello Quickstart—swap to the new unified SDK init, collapse the example Dockerfile, and clarify auth env var. Can @Leo or @Jun take a quick look?
Leo: Yep. Prefer SDK-first. Keep a one-line curl as a smoke check. Also: the current Python snippet imports `OldClient` — needs update.
Jun: I'll patch the py snippet to use `RedwoodClient` and show safe access for output like `text = resp.output[0].text if resp.output else resp.text`.
docs-bot: /docs/lint — warning: code fence missing language tag in one spot.
Ava: fixing now, adding language tags and a short table mapping `REDWOOD_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for folks on older guides.
Leo: Small wording ask: change "5-minute setup" to "Quickstart: get running in minutes". Also remove the `--platform` flag from Docker to avoid arm confusion.
Jun: Added a tiny smoke script snippet (`npm run smoke`) and a one-liner health check for CI.
Ava: pushed fixes (commit c3f2). CI re-run queued.
docs-bot: /docs/lint — all checks passed.
Leo: LGTM, approving. Thanks — will merge after CI completes.
Ava: thanks! I'll cherry-pick the migration note into the migration guide after merge. :tada:
